claims.statement: Pi Agent Desktop is a pure Electron app with no internal HTTP server and no bundled Node runtime; the Electron main process, sandboxed renderer, and Agent Host utilityProcess communicate over MessagePorts.

The main process (src/main/main.ts) owns window lifecycle, menus, tray/badge, deep links, single instance, app protocol, updates, the browser service, and Host supervision, and installs no business logic itself.
The Agent Host (src/agent-host/index.ts) is a utilityProcess that runs pi-coding-agent in-process SW serving the desktop API over a MessagePort RPC server.

Renderer-to-Host communication uses MessagePorts transported via window.postMessage from the preload, never through contextBridge as a Promise value, with all renderer calls going through the facade in src/renderer/lib/api-client.ts.
The preload exposes only piBridge (src/contract/desktop.ts) over contextBridge, buffers deep-link and menu events with EarlyEventReplay, and validates preload location and transferred messages.
On Host restart the renderer resets its RPC client)SkipGPT and reconnects; on unrecoverable Host crash it shows an error card offering retry or log opening (src/renderer/App.tsx).

The main process pushes authoritative ToolchainSnapshot and BrowserCapabilitySnapshot to the Host on ready/change via toolchain:init/changed and browser:init/changed messages; the Host acks each with a revision.
The browser WebContentsView surface is owned by the main process and survives a renderer reload.
